description: This file contains functions for managing tags and their associations with objects in the Apache Superset project, including adding type, owner, and favorite tags to various objects like charts, dashboards, saved queries, and datasets.

methods.name: add_types
methods.description: Tags objects according to their type (chart, dashboard, query, dataset) by inserting records into tagged_object table.

methods.name: add_owners
methods.description: Tags objects with their owner information by creating owner-specific tags and associating them with objects.

methods.name: add_favorites
methods.description: Tags objects that have been favorited by users, creating user-specific favorite tags.
